text:
[Council File 26-1228]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the employment status of the former LA CityView Channel 35 contractor workers, and the applicability and enforcement of the City’s Worker Retention Ordinance.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. NOTE and FILE the Information Technology Agency (ITA) report dated September 23, 2026, and the City Attorney reports dated October 14, 2026 and October 29, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. INSTRUCT the ITA to engage with CKC Squadron Holding LLC dba Squadron (Squadron) regarding amendments to their contract that includes the following:
a. Restore the eight-hour minimum for regular production and post-production assignments.
b. Define the paid production day from the first required duty through the final required duty.
c. Restore City-provided transportation when assignments require City equipment.
d. Require reimbursement for necessary assignment expenses.
e. Clarify responsibility for production equipment.
f. Establish clear cancellation protections.
g. Establish transparent rates by classification.
h. Require disclosure of Squadron’s administrative markup.
i. Require prompt payment timeline.
j. Establish objective and consistent contractor selection and removal criteria.
k. Processes to protect and retain the experienced workforce.
l. Add explicit non-retaliation protections.
m. Protect union organizing and collective activity.
n. Review the level of City control over subcontractors.
o. Require Council oversight of any subcontract term changes.
p. Require all prime contract protections to flow down to subcontractors.
q. Establish written production capacity and service standards.
r. Require regular reporting to the ITA.
s. Establish a formal dispute and escalation process.
t. Establish meaningful remedies for noncompliance.
u. Establish public service and production coverage standards.
v. Require assignment transparency.
w. Require approval of material subcontract changes.
x. Protect subcontractor portfolio and copyright use rights.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
